globalStyle: SNES 16-bit pixel art combat effect animation, limited color palette, chunky clean pixels, retro tactical RPG visual effect, glowing energy on a solid pure black background

combat_fx.stylePrefix: sprite sheet of exactly 4 animation frames arranged in a 2x2 grid, each frame centered in its quadrant, frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom showing the effect appear, peak, and dissipate, solid pure black background, no grid lines, no borders, no text

assets.name: fx_slash
assets.prompt: curved sword slash arc, bright white and cyan crescent blade trail sweeping from left to right, thin trailing sparks, elegant fast cut

assets.name: fx_chop
assets.prompt: heavy axe chop impact arc, thick orange and yellow crescent slash with jagged edges and metallic sparks, brutal downward-diagonal strike oriented left to right

assets.name: fx_thrust
assets.prompt: lance thrust streak, narrow horizontal spear pierce line with bright white-blue glowing tip and speed lines, pointing to the right

assets.name: fx_arrow
assets.prompt: arrow strike impact, small arrow with glowing yellow motion trail flying to the right ending in a sharp impact flash with tiny debris sparks

assets.name: fx_magic
assets.prompt: arcane fire magic burst, swirling red-orange and purple explosion of mystic energy expanding outward from center with small runic embers

assets.name: fx_light
assets.prompt: holy light magic burst, radiant golden-white column and rays of divine light shining down at center, soft glowing motes rising

assets.name: fx_heal
assets.prompt: healing sparkle effect, gentle green and white plus-shaped sparkles and rising glittering motes of restorative light at center

assets.name: fx_crit
assets.prompt: critical hit starburst, dramatic yellow-white star-shaped impact flash with radial shock lines exploding outward from center
